name: places100-hard
description: A challenging subset of the Places scene-recognition benchmark designed to stress recognition models on hard examples. It measures models' ability to classify scene images into place categories under difficult conditions (ambiguous contexts, rare viewpoints, or confusing backgrounds). The split is intended to provide a tougher evaluation than the standard Places subsets.
reputation: Derived from the widely used Places dataset family; this "hard" subset is less common but useful for stress-testing scene-recognition models.
